name: spawn_knowledge_filter_raw_interp_rejected
description: The spawn knowledge filter is an expression the checker walks, so `{!expr}` in it is rejected (#538)
input:
agent worker
  memory
    topic: Text
  on start
    say "up"

  if stuck for 3 turns
    escalate to human

task run_it
  do
    topic = "TASKS"
    spawn worker as "w"
      with knowledge where category == "{!topic}"

error_contains: raw interpolation was removed in v0.3
